points.description: States that usable life is a period of time (the duration for which the reservoir continues to serve/function) that extends beyond the useful/economic life.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only says period/time the reservoir lasts, without relating it to going beyond the useful/economic life.

points.description: States that during this period the reservoir can still serve only some of its purposes (partial/limited service) until it is finally no longer usable.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only vaguely says the reservoir keeps working or is still in use, without saying only some purposes are served.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both ideas: a time period extending beyond the useful/economic life, and the reservoir still serving some (not all) of its purposes. Give part marks for a vague or half-stated idea, such as just 'the time the reservoir lasts'. Give no marks for wrong definitions, such as equating usable life with useful life or full service life.
